entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: A planeswalker, the most powerful of the early story planeswalkers, who was killed by Urza during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: The evil Sorceress Queen of Rabiah who tried to use the Taysirs and barred him from returning.

entities.name: El-Hajjâj
entities.description: Nailah's father who hid the baby Taysir.

entities.name: Raghib
entities.description: A former lover of Nailah, cursed with leprosy, who became the servant of the white Taysir.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Taysir loved, killed by Tevesh Szat in the assault on Phyrexia.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker who called the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed Kristina and Daria during the attack on Phyrexia.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: An evil planeswalker whom Taysir imprisoned in Phyrexia instead of killing.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Taysir's apprentice, brought back to life by Taysir and Kristina, who secretly hated them.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: Ravidel's friend killed at the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Taysir and Kristina aided in casting the World Spell.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: A minotaur planeswalker whom Kristina loved and whom Taysir banished.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: The planeswalker guardian of Ulgrotha who killed Taysir with a broadsword.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: A young native planeswalker of Ulgrotha, Taysir's apprentice and foster daughter, killed by Szat.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who recruited the Nine Titans and killed Taysir with the kill rubric.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A Titan who performed the ritual of Dalfir on Taysir's corpse.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who opted out of the Titans at the last minute.

entities.name: Nine Titans
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers Urza recruited for the attack on Phyrexia.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Taysir's home plane, which Nailah barred him from returning to.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Sandruu's homeworld, where Taysir was killed.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: A twelve-plane nexus that trapped planeswalkers on Dominaria.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: The spell that ended the Ice Age and the time of the Shard.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Taysir joined the attack on Phyrexia and died.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Urza's Titans attacked.

events.summary: During the Thousandfold Refraction of Rabiah, Taysir is copied only five times, once for each color.
events.quote: he was copied only five times, once for each color of mana, instead of a thousand times

events.summary: Nailah seduces the black Taysir and has him kill and absorb the green one.
events.quote: Nailah seduced the black version of Taysir and had him kill and absorb the green one

events.summary: The nomad Taysir defeats Nailah and merges with his last counterpart, becoming the most powerful wizard in the multiverse.
events.quote: The Nomad Taysir eventually came back for the others, defeated Nailah, and merged with his last living counterpart.

events.summary: After Taysir becomes a planeswalker, Nailah's seduction fails; he blasts her and leaves, and she bars him from returning.
events.quote: created a barrier around the Rabiahs, preventing him from ever returning.

events.summary: Taysir is trapped in the Shard on Dominaria and falls in love with Kristina of the Woods on Corondor.
events.quote: he met and fell in love with a fellow planeswalker Kristina of the Woods .

events.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupts among the planeswalkers; Ravidel and Rhuell die and Taysir and Kristina revive Ravidel.
events.quote: Taysir and his lover combined their magic to bring Ravidel back to life

events.summary: Taysir and Kristina help Freyalise cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard; the two part ways.
events.quote: This ended the Ice Age of Dominaria and ended the time of the Shard.

events.summary: Taysir defeats Leshrac but cannot kill him and imprisons him deep in Phyrexia instead.
events.quote: he imprisoned Leshrac deep in hellish Phyrexia instead

events.summary: Taysir attacks Sandruu, banishes him to a remote plane, and is killed by Feroz on Ulgrotha.
events.quote: killed him by splitting his skull with a broadsword.

events.summary: Over two centuries the Anaba Ancestors redeem Taysir's spirit and he returns in a withered body, taking Daria as apprentice.
events.quote: On Ulgrotha he found a young native planeswalker, Daria , and took her as his apprentice and as his foster daughter.

events.summary: Taysir is recruited among the Nine Titans for the attack on Phyrexia, with Daria taking Teferi's place and Urza insisting on Szat.
events.quote: Taysir was one of the Nine Titans recruited by Urza to participate in the attack on Phyrexia.

events.summary: Szat kills Kristina and later Daria during the assault.
events.quote: Szat killed Kristina by "accident" early in the assault, then hunted down and deliberately killed Daria later on.

events.summary: When Urza switches allegiance to Phyrexia, Taysir attacks him and Urza kills him by activating the kill rubric in his Titan Engine.
events.quote: Urza activated the kill rubric in Taysir's Titan Engine , killing him.

events.summary: Lord Windgrace performs the ritual of Dalfir on Taysir's body.
events.quote: performed the ritual of Dalfir on him
